title: Systematic evaluation of released AMP predictors: analysis code and processed statistical inputs
description: Analysis and figure-generation software under Apache-2.0, with eight bundled processed statistical input files and frozen outputs under CC BY 4.0 (see docs/LICENSING.md for scopes and source attribution). Supports the added sequence-baseline, within-family and group-separated selection analyses from saved model outputs. Historical raw sequence letters are omitted; exact sequence SHA256 identities, labels, groups, scores and decisions are retained. Third-party model weights and original source publications/workbooks are not included. The earlier v1.0.0 archive is code-only; cite the actual updated release used.
